submitted.rationale: Monoclinic BiVO4 (Bi:V=1:1) is the known photoactive phase under 3.22 eV illumination. I measured the compositions around 1:1. Photocurrent rose steeply toward the V-rich side: 0.31 µA at V=0.436, 5.3 µA at V=0.508 and 23.3 µA at V=0.564. Index 10 had the highest measured merit.

rejected.reason: Measured 5.3 µA, about 4x lower than index 10
Measured 0.31 µA. The Bi-rich side is poor, probably because of Bi-rich secondary phases
V=0.571 is almost the same as index 10 and could be comparable, but it was not measured because the budget ran out
Photocurrent fell sharply as Bi content increased, so these compositions are expected to be poor
